products.name: Merative (formerly Watson Health)
products.note: Healthcare data analytics; clinical AI; population health; PHI governance

profile_text.body:
Merative is a healthcare data, technology, and analytics company that describes itself as providing trusted technology and human expertise to support decision-making and performance across the healthcare industry. The company was formerly known as Watson Health and serves healthcare providers, payers, life sciences organizations, and government health programs. Its portfolio spans clinical decision support, imaging, clinical data management, real-world evidence, and health data analytics.

Merative's products include Micromedex, a clinical decision support solution aimed at equipping clinicians with point-of-care insights; Zelta, a cloud-based unified clinical data management and acquisition platform designed for clinical trials; and a suite of enterprise imaging tools under the Merge brand, including Merge VNA, Merge Universal Viewer, Merge Workflow Orchestrator, Merge Cardio, and Merge Hemo, with Merge Cardio and Merge Hemo described as 2025 Best in KLAS ranked. Truven, another offering, provides health data analytics and consulting services. The company also offers a portfolio of data, services, and applications for real-world evidence studies. Customer-reported outcomes cited on the company's site include a jump from a 17% to 80% auto-renewal rate for MAGI Medicaid, 36,000 hours in time savings, and nearly $1.3 million in cost savings within a single cohort.

The site's held facts classify Merative under Healthcare and Life Sciences AI, noting its work in healthcare data analytics, clinical AI, population health, and PHI governance.
